title: Fictional custody-exchange allegation verification

parent.objective: Maintain a source-pinned record of disputed parenting-time events for the fictional Doe v. Doe matter, distinguishing an alleged event from one confirmed against a primary source.
parent.milestone: Custody allegation checked against the fictional hearing transcript

goal: Track the alleged missed custody exchange as an allegation until a non-implementer has checked the fictional hearing transcript, then record what the transcript actually shows.
non_goals: Advise on relief, remedy, or admissibility.
Treat the allegation as fact before a primary source has been checked.

allowed: Track the allegation and its declared fact status.
Record a primary-source check of the fictional transcript exhibit against the allegation.
prohibited: Assert the allegation as fact without a bound source verification record.
Introduce real people, events, or transcripts.

inputs.name: Fictional allegation
inputs.description: Party B alleges Party A failed to appear for the scheduled fictional 2026-02-14 custody exchange. Fictional; establishes no real event.

outputs.name: Fact-status record
outputs.description: The allegation with its declared category, and once checked, the outcome of the primary-source review.

interface.name: fictional_custody_allegation
interface.description: Input the allegation; output its declared and, once earned, its ledger-derived fact status.

assumptions: The allegation and the transcript exhibit it will be checked against are both invented for this worked example.

sources.reference: The fictional allegation embedded in this contract's inputs.
sources.authority: Party B's own fictional account; not independently established.

sources.reference: Fictional 2026-03-02 hearing transcript exhibit (illustrative only; not present in this repository).
sources.authority: Would be a primary record if real; here it is a synthetic placeholder for the worked example.

acceptance_criteria.description: The allegation is declared ALLEGATION, never a stronger category, until a review is bound and attested.
A non-implementer reviews the transcript exhibit and records whether it supports, contradicts, or is inconclusive on the allegation.

validation.description: Confirm the fact-status record declares ALLEGATION, not a stronger category.

argv: declared = 'ALLEGATION'; assert declared == 'ALLEGATION'; print('declared status is ALLEGATION, not earned')

validation.description: A non-implementer reads the fictional hearing transcript exhibit and confirms whether it supports the allegation.
evidence_required: A source verification record binding the reviewed transcript, its outcome, and the reviewing operator.

context_scope: This contract and the embedded fictional allegation.
architecture_boundaries: Keep the allegation distinct from an earned VERIFIED_FACT until the ledger's primary-source review is attested.
Make no legal determination and perform no external writes.

fact_assertions.assertion: Party A failed to appear for the scheduled 2026-02-14 custody exchange.
